body:
We are a server with a small, dedicated worldwide playerbase looking to grow organically and find new friends who value a server that will still be here week to week, month to month, and even year to year. Progress will not be reset so play at your own pace and enjoy the company of friends.

Our server features primarily Create and its many addons.
